title: Rav Anan bar Chiyya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Ketubot 21a mentions a document issued by Mar Shmuel’s court, recording that Rav Anan bar Chiyya came and testified, with another witness—Rav Chanan bar Rabbah (or Rava). Hyman considers it very likely that he is the Anan bar Chiyya of Yevamot 115a: a bill of divorce found in Sura read, “In the town of Sura, I, Anan bar Chiyya of Nehardea…” The Rabbis searched from Sura to Nehardea and found no other Anan bar Chiyya apart from Anan bar Chiyya of Hagra. Hyman argues that Abaye and Rava’s dispute about this does not mean that the incident occurred in their time; they disputed the ruling. In Hyman’s reconstruction, he is the Rav Anan bar Chiyya mentioned above.

notes.text: Hyman considers the court witness and the man in the found divorce document probably identical; this remains a conjecture. Rabbah/Rava is his stated variant.

The consulted Ketubot 21a explicitly names Rav Anan bar Chiyya and Rav Chanan bar Rabbah as reciprocal witnesses in Mar Shmuel’s court document. Hyman’s supplied Rava alternative, probable identification with the Yevamot divorce-document figure and explanation of the Abaye/Rava chronology remain his reconstruction. A historical note marked HOLD is retained without changing active holds.
